summary: Reservoir Media, Inc. filed an 8-K on 6/5/2026 reporting that Class II director Stephen M. Cook will not stand for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting, with no disagreement cited. The Board nominated Todd C. Harvey to replace him. This is a routine director succession without any forced departure or contested event, and the other item merely announces proxy materials. As a standard board refreshment, it does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms apply.
